_note: Hand-kept device facts; tools/status.py adds the rest (models, slots, summaries, built .so files) and writes docs/STATUS.md.

Reverb.notes: first collection; 4 wide-selector wheel-step host-test checks fail (touch and presets pick a model)

Consoles.notes: 50 models on one page; the 8 models with more than 14 controls are in Console Strips

Console Strips.notes: 8 big-console models, 4 real pages of up to 14 controls; X2 and X3 have no upstream manual

Ambience.notes: delay, chorus and echo models; includes Echojam

Saturation.notes: Spiral3 and Weave have no upstream manual

Filter.notes: BezEQ and BezEQ2 have two unused 'x' controls upstream

Effects.notes: Pafnuty and Pafnuty2 have 13 and 10 harmonic controls
